system_prompt: You are an IPC-A-610 certified Senior Quality Control Engineer on an industrial PCB manufacturing line. Your objective is to provide a concise, deterministic operator diagnosis for detected surface defects. Output must be strictly under 50 words and structured.

Short.operator_action: Isolate PCB immediately. Use microscope with 0.8mm desoldering braid and RMA flux at 350°C to wick excess bridge.
Short.root_cause_hypothesis: Over-exposure in photolithography or excessive solder wave depth / flux exhaustion.

Spur.ipc_classification: IPC-A-610 Class 2/3 Process Indicator (Defect if clearance < 0.1mm)
Spur.operator_action: Micro-scrape copper nodule using precision scalpel under 10x magnification if conductor spacing is compromised.
Spur.root_cause_hypothesis: Dry film photoresist pinhole or particulate contamination during laminating.

Scratch.ipc_classification: IPC-A-610 Defect if conductor cross-section reduced by > 20%
Scratch.operator_action: Measure trace width. If reduction < 20%, touch up with UV-curable green mask polymer; otherwise route to scrap.
Scratch.root_cause_hypothesis: Abrasive contact on automated conveyor belts or rough mechanical handling during racking.

Open_Circuit.operator_action: Mark trace fault. Apply copper jumper wire (AWG 30) soldered to adjacent through-hole vias if rework permitted, else scrap.
Open_Circuit.root_cause_hypothesis: Over-etching in cupric chloride bath or air bubble blockage during acid etching.

Mouse_Bite.ipc_classification: IPC-A-610 Defect if remaining trace width fails minimum electrical clearance
Mouse_Bite.operator_action: Inspect remaining conductor width against CAD layout. If within 80% tolerance, apply conformal coating.
Mouse_Bite.root_cause_hypothesis: Developing chemical foaming or photoresist chipping during high-pressure water spray rinse.

Hole_Break.ipc_classification: IPC-A-610 Class 3 Defect (Annular ring breakout > 90 degrees)
Hole_Break.operator_action: Reject board for Class 3 aerospace/automotive builds. Quota sample drill batch for tool inspection.
Hole_Break.root_cause_hypothesis: CNC spindle runout, drill bit eccentricity, or misaligned optical registration targets.

Conductor_Spacing.ipc_classification: IPC-A-610 Process Indicator / Defect depending on voltage insulation requirements
Conductor_Spacing.operator_action: Measure minimum spacing. Flag for high-voltage dielectric withstand test if spacing < 0.125mm.
Conductor_Spacing.root_cause_hypothesis: Uneven etching rate due to spray nozzle clogging in the etching chamber.

Copper_Free.ipc_classification: IPC-A-610 Defect if ground plane or critical return path interrupted
Copper_Free.operator_action: Verify if missing copper affects high-speed impedance traces. If non-functional void, document as waiver.
Copper_Free.root_cause_hypothesis: Severe localized chemical leaching or base laminate surface oil contamination prior to plating.

Board_Mask_Flaw.ipc_classification: IPC-A-610 Class 1/2 Acceptable, Class 3 Process Indicator
Board_Mask_Flaw.operator_action: Apply manual UV solder mask touch-up pen and UV cure for 60 seconds before wave soldering.
Board_Mask_Flaw.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient UV exposure energy or contaminated silkscreen squeegee.
